items.title: Wall Street finally turned staking into a dividend, now Ethereum and Solana want to shrink it
items.whyYouShouldCare: The shift towards treating staking as a dividend could enhance Solana's appeal to investors seeking yield, impacting liquidity and ecosystem growth.

items.title: Inside the Solana reinsurance sale where parent company Oxbridge supplied 95% of public token demand
items.whyYouShouldCare: Oxbridge's significant contribution to the Solana reinsurance sale indicates strong institutional interest, which could bolster market confidence and liquidity.

items.title: Ethereum and Solana may become scarcer – THESE Grayscale projections say…
